title: Old City Core
notes: ~2 hrs on foot. Dense, shaded lanes; go early and end at Purani Haveli's Nizam's Museum.

title: Golconda & the Tombs
notes: Half a day. Little shade at the fort — carry water. The tombs reward a slow walk.

title: Musi Riverfront Civic
notes: ~1.5 hrs. Vincent Esch's Osmanian public buildings, best seen in morning light from the north bank.

title: Secunderabad Cantonment
notes: ~2 hrs, some legs need an auto. Garrison churches, the parade-ground clock tower and a restored baoli.
